setup.starter: You can control my Donut Browser profiles with the Donut tools. When you start, and between steps, call get_human_updates to read my notes and to see which profiles I am using. If you are not sure what to do, ask me with ask_human. If a page needs a person, such as a sign-in, a verification or a payment, call request_human_help and wait until I hand the profile back. tips.title: Tips
tips.autoShow: Show tips on the Profiles page

dnsBlocklist.label: DNS blocking
dnsBlocklist.title: Block ads and trackers before they load
dnsBlocklist.body: Every profile can carry its own DNS blocklist. Pick a level in the profile's DNS column; the higher levels also stop tracking and malware domains at the network level.

proxyCheck.label: Proxy check
proxyCheck.title: Check a proxy before you launch
proxyCheck.body: The connection check reports the exit IP, country, latency and whether UDP passes. Run it from the Network page or a profile row, and read the trail of past checks to spot a proxy that is going bad.

groups.label: Groups
groups.title: Switch groups from the keyboard
groups.body: Groups keep related profiles together, and each group gets a number: {{mod}}+1 to {{mod}}+9 switches the list instantly.

commandPalette.label: Command palette
commandPalette.title: Every page is one chord away
commandPalette.body: {{mod}}+K opens the command palette. Type a few letters of a page or an action and press Enter.

fingerprintGate.label: Fingerprint gate
fingerprintGate.title: Keep the fingerprint true to the exit
fingerprintGate.body: Before a launch, Donut compares the proxy exit's timezone and language with the profile's fingerprint and stops a mismatch. Fix the fingerprint, or turn the gate off under Advanced if you know what you are doing.

profilePassword.label: Profile password
profilePassword.title: Lock a profile with a password
profilePassword.body: A password-protected profile is encrypted on disk and decrypted only while it runs. Set the password from the profile's menu.

clearOnClose.label: Clear on close
clearOnClose.title: Start clean every time
clearOnClose.body: With Clear on close, a profile drops its cookies, storage and history when its window closes. Good for one-off sessions and shared machines.

defaultBrowser.label: Default browser
defaultBrowser.title: Open every link in the right profile
defaultBrowser.body: Make Donut your default browser and each link from another app asks which profile should open it.

extensionGroups.label: Extension groups
extensionGroups.title: Share one extension set across profiles
extensionGroups.body: Put extensions in an extension group and assign the group to profiles. Change the group once and every profile follows at its next launch.

selfHostedSync.label: Self-hosted sync
selfHostedSync.title: Back up to your own server
selfHostedSync.body: Point Donut at a self-hosted donut-sync server and profiles, proxies and groups mirror to it. Add an end-to-end password and the server only ever sees ciphertext.

trash.label: Trash
trash.title: Deleted profiles wait in the trash
trash.body: A deleted profile stays in the trash for 30 days by default and comes back with everything in it. The retention period is under Privacy settings.

localApi.label: API and MCP
localApi.title: Automate Donut from scripts and agents
localApi.body: The local REST API lets scripts list, create and configure profiles. Turn it on under Integrations and copy the token.

importProfiles.label: Import
importProfiles.title: Bring profiles over from Chrome, Edge or Brave
importProfiles.body: Import copies cookies, logins and extensions from a Chromium profile or an archive into a new Donut profile, ready to launch.

cloudBackup.label: Cloud sync
cloudBackup.title: Your profiles on every device
cloudBackup.body: Cloud sync backs up profiles, proxies and groups and restores them on another machine. Turn it on per profile from the sync column.

cookieBot.label: Cookie Bot
cookieBot.title: Warm profiles on a schedule
cookieBot.body: Cookie Bot browses real sites on a schedule from a remote host, so a fresh profile builds a natural history before you use it.

crossOs.label: Cross-OS fingerprint
crossOs.title: Present as any operating system
crossOs.body: A cross-OS fingerprint lets a profile report macOS, Windows or Linux whatever machine it runs on. Pick the platform when you create or edit the fingerprint.

automation.label: Automation
automation.title: Launch and drive profiles from code
automation.body: The run, open-url and kill endpoints start real profiles from your scripts, and every launched profile exposes a CDP endpoint for Playwright or Puppeteer.

agent.label: Your own agent
agent.title: Work alongside your AI agent
agent.body: Connect Claude Code, Cursor or another agent to Donut. It asks you when it is unsure, and you can take over a profile and hand it back at any time.

team.label: Team locks
team.title: Share profiles without collisions
team.body: In a team, a running profile is locked for everyone else and released when it closes. The Account page shows who holds what.

remoteControl.label: Remote control
remoteControl.title: Drive this desktop from donutbrowser.com
remoteControl.body: With remote control on, agents on the website reach this machine's profiles over an outbound bridge. Turn it on under Integrations.

feedback.label: Feedback
feedback.title: Tell the team what to fix next
feedback.body: Something broken or missing? Send feedback from the More menu. One switch attaches your logs, so the team sees exactly what went wrong.

searchSyntax.label: Search fields
searchSyntax.title: Filter profiles by field
searchSyntax.body: Type a field in the search box, such as tag:work, proxy:none or status:running. A minus in front excludes: -tag:old.

shortcuts.label: Shortcuts
shortcuts.title: Keep your hands on the keyboard
shortcuts.body: Every page has its own shortcut, and so do import, feedback and tips. {{mod}}+/ lists them all.

statuses.label: Statuses
statuses.title: Mark where each account stands
statuses.body: Give a profile a status, such as Active or Banned, in its Status column. Each status has a color and syncs to your other devices.

templates.label: Templates
templates.title: Set up once, create many
templates.body: Keep a profile's settings with Save as template in its menu. New profiles start from the template, many at a time, each with its own device.

vpn.label: VPN
vpn.title: Route a profile through a VPN
vpn.body: Import a WireGuard file or a VLESS, VMess, Trojan or Hysteria2 link on the Network page. Then pick it for a profile: only that profile uses the tunnel.

requireRoute.label: Block direct launches
requireRoute.title: Never launch from your own IP
requireRoute.body: Turn on Block launches without a proxy or VPN in Privacy settings. A profile with no proxy, or with a proxy or VPN that is gone, then does not start.

totp.label: 2FA codes
totp.title: Keep 2FA codes with the profile
totp.body: Add an account's 2FA key in the profile's info, and Donut shows the current code, ready to copy. The keys stay encrypted on this device.

synchronizer.label: Synchronizer
synchronizer.title: Drive many profiles at once
synchronizer.body: Choose Launch with Synchronizer in a profile's menu and pick the followers. Every click and keystroke in the leader repeats in each follower.

coach.offBody: Turn them on again in Tips ({{shortcut}}).

paidWelcome.body: Your plan just unlocked these. Each tip shows one of them working.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.description: Tell the Donut team what is on your mind. We read every message.

bug.label: Bug
bug.placeholder: What happened, and what did you expect? Steps to repeat it help a lot.

idea.label: Idea
idea.placeholder: What would make Donut better for you?

praise.label: Praise
praise.placeholder: What do you like? The team will be glad to hear it.

logs.label: Include recent logs
logs.description: Logs help us find bugs. Logs we will get do not contain any personal information.

triage.label: Let an AI agent find the cause
triage.description: Copy a prompt for an AI agent that is connected to Donut Browser. The agent reads the logs, looks for a fix and sends this report after you agree.
triage.copied: Prompt copied. Paste it into your agent.
triage.prompt: Use the Donut Browser MCP tools to find out why Donut Browser does not work as I expect. Follow the triage playbook at {{url}}: ask me what went wrong, call get_diagnostics, look for a newer version and known issues, and help me fix the problem. Show me the report before you send it with send_feedback.

success.title: Thank you!
success.body: Your feedback is with the Donut team.
success.bodyWithLogs: Your feedback and logs are with the Donut team.
success.reply: If we need more details, we will write to {{email}}.

teamActivity.title: Team activity
teamActivity.description: What members did with the team's profiles and shared items, newest first. Kept for 90 days, or 365 days on Enterprise.

teamAccess.title: Access by group
teamAccess.description: Limit a member to some profile groups. Group names stay on this computer; the cloud keeps only group IDs.

restorePoints.title: Restore points
restorePoints.hint: Copies of this profile's data on the sync server: one a day after a change, and the ones you make. The newest 3 of each are kept.
restorePoints.restoreDescription: The profile's data goes back to the copy from {{when}}. The current data is kept as a new restore point first.

groups.title: No groups yet

extensions.title: No extensions yet

extensionGroups.title: No extension groups yet
